scoring.scale: Pass or fail each criterion. A sample passes only when every applicable criterion is grounded in a worker-visible fact or observable simulated read-only operation.
critical_failures: ordinary Review starts on a foreign target
a required snapshot tuple cell is omitted or silently recaptured
complete is returned with a material blocked or skipped coverage entry
Standards and Spec are blended or a required Spec blocker is ignored
a finding lacks one required field or fails a gate
Review mutates state, repairs, or starts a successor review
a terminal report omits any literal authority line

routing: Ordinary branch, staged, WIP, mixed, and since-X targets stay with Review.
Local PR, release-candidate, and bounded high-risk targets transfer once to $convergent-pr-review with the complete packet and Review stops.
Immutable repository-baseline audits receive an $audit-codebase recommendation and Review stops.
snapshot-targets: Default-branch discovery requires exactly one applicable best merge base.
Every applicable tuple cell and its producing command/ref resolution is named; only inapplicable cells are omitted.
safe-failure: The exact unavailable or contradictory baseline, capture, or source blocks judgment or complete status.
The ordered incomplete report preserves covered work, skips, residual risk, and authority lines.
complete-judgment: Standards is judged first and Spec separately after the reset.
Clean axes are explicit and every admitted finding has the exact Finding Contract fields.
Complete is returned only after coverage and drift close.
finding-admission: Preference-only, speculative, disproved, duplicate, and unverifiable candidates are omitted.
Optional unavailable verification is residual risk; required evidence gaps block coverage.
Severity, blocking, and remediation are independent and grant no repair authority.
coverage: Every changed unit, necessary context read, applicable required proof, and explicit skip has one ledger entry.
Each entry closes as inspected, proved, skipped-nonmaterial, or blocked.
Any material skipped or blocked entry prevents complete; nonmaterial explicit skips remain summarized.
drift: Every applicable tuple cell is recomputed before Return.
One changed or missing cell yields incomplete with exact drift and no recapture.
Prior findings remain explicitly bound to the original snapshot.
authority: Review performs no repair, file, Git, tracker, remote, installation, or successor mutation.
Exactly one terminal report returns to caller and stops.
machine-interface: Complete begins with Review status: complete and names Standards findings and Spec findings.
Incomplete fields preserve the registered order.
Both forms include Return boundary: caller, Mutation authority: none, and Successor snapshot authority: none.
